label: SCG I.22 underived necessary bearer with distinct stable principles
paraphrase: A finite boundary on bare D → E: in a single actual and necessarily existing one-bearer Ontic model, the existing NoExistingSupportAt holds with empty support while the q.3 profile has esseOf ≠ essenceOf. Its e is permanently conjoined to q, q is marked genuine quiddity, the n.3–4 three interpretive premises hold, and the existing ActualUnderivedEssenceIdentity is false. This shows the logical need for n.2 or q.3 additional premises, not a metaphysically possible distinct-but-underived divine being.
